name: Arizona
headline_status: Recreational and medical cannabis are legal for adults 21+, with licensed stores selling since January 2021.
summary: Arizona voters approved adult-use cannabis through Proposition 207 in November 2020, and licensed sales started on January 22, 2021; medical cannabis has been legal since 2010. Adults 21+ may carry up to one ounce, including no more than 5 grams of concentrate, and grow up to six plants at home. Adult-use purchases carry a 16% excise tax on top of regular sales tax. A Republican-backed initiative to end adult-use sales was abandoned in May 2026 before it gathered signatures, so it did not reach the November 2026 ballot.

adult_use_since.value: Proposition 207 passed Nov. 3, 2020 with 60% of the vote; possession became legal when results were certified on Nov. 30, 2020.

medical_since.value: Medical marijuana has been legal since 2010.

possession_limit.value: Up to 1 ounce, of which no more than 5 grams may be concentrate. Holding between 1 and 2.5 ounces is a petty offense with a maximum $300 fine.

home_grow.value: Up to 6 plants per adult, kept in a locked, enclosed area out of public view.

public_use.value: Smoking cannabis in public places and open spaces is illegal and treated as a petty offense.

retail_sales.value: Adult-use sales began Jan. 22, 2021, when the state approved 86 licenses, mostly to existing medical dispensaries. Home delivery has been allowed since Nov. 1, 2024.

taxes.value: 16% excise tax on adult-use sales plus the regular state sales (transaction privilege) tax of 5.6%.

regulator.value: Arizona Department of Health Services (ADHS), Bureau of Marijuana Licensing.

expungement.value: People can petition to expunge past records for possessing up to 2.5 ounces, growing up to six plants at home, and related paraphernalia offenses.

dui.value: Zero tolerance: Arizona bans driving with any amount of a listed drug, including marijuana, or its metabolite in the body, even without proof of impairment.

tourists.value: Yes. Prop 207 lets any adult 21+ buy and possess up to 1 ounce, of which no more than 5 grams may be concentrate, with no residency requirement.

faq.a: Yes. Adults 21 and older can legally possess and buy cannabis from licensed dispensaries, which have sold to adults since January 2021.

faq.q: How much weed can you have in Arizona?
faq.a: Up to one ounce, with no more than 5 grams of that as concentrate. Carrying between one and 2.5 ounces is a petty offense with a fine of up to $300.

faq.q: Can you grow cannabis at home in Arizona?
faq.a: Yes. Adults may grow up to six plants in a locked, enclosed space that cannot be seen from public view.

faq.q: What is the tax on recreational weed in Arizona?
faq.a: Adult-use purchases carry a 16% excise tax plus the regular 5.6% state sales tax.
